name: MavlinOS
description: Evidence-driven Linux OS project targeting faithful macOS Mavericks 10.9 UI/UX with an optimized Linux foundation.
currentFocus: Reverse-engineer Mavericks system UI and shared behavior
Correlate REA NIB/keyed-archive evidence with Ghidra native analysis and nsinspect runtime captures
Complete evidence-backed UI_REFERENCE and UI_PLATFORM specifications
targetSystem: Linux; final distribution, toolkit, compositor, and window manager remain evidence-driven decisions
hardwareStrategy: Generic Linux core with optional hardware profiles; MacBook10,1 is a reference profile, not the product definition.
implementationStatus: Research-first; no stable installation image or production release.
